Selected Work

A few projects from each area I work in. The full list, with each project's docs, is in my project directory .

Parametric CAD & the OpenSCAD ecosystem

Designs defined in code: parameterized, reproducible, and testable.

  • openscad-web · try it live
    A full OpenSCAD editor, 3D previewer, and customizer that runs in the browser on a WebAssembly build of the OpenSCAD engine — no install, no server.
  • DraftSCAD
    An OpenSCAD library for dimensioned, annotated engineering drawings — leader lines, hole centres, title blocks — generated from code.
  • scadbatch
    Batch-exports models from a parametric OpenSCAD design using CSV or Customizer JSON parameter sets. CLI, GUI, and Python API.

Hardware-engineering & developer tooling

Tools that put engineering software under program control and check its output against declared intent — much of it now under heibench .

  • gerberdiff · docs
    Diffs PCB fabrication files (Gerber/Excellon), reporting exactly what moved, resized, was added, or was removed between revisions, with visual overlays and a CI-friendly exit code.
  • partspec
    Checks a code-defined CAD part against a written specification of what it is supposed to be, so a geometry change that breaks the design contract fails like a unit test. Pre-alpha.
  • agent-policy · docs
    Generates every AI-coding-assistant config a repository needs from one canonical policy file, and detects drift in CI. Published to crates.io, npm, and PyPI.
  • freeboard · try it live
    A modernized rebuild of the Freeboard real-time dashboard builder: Vue 3, GraphQL and PostgreSQL, and a hardened gateway for HTTP, SSE, WebSocket, and MQTT sources.

Open scientific & lab hardware

Open designs for research equipment, mostly with the FAST Research Group.

  • desktop-sheet-press · paper
    An open-source cold and hot sheet press for testing polymer materials. I designed the electrical system, PID control, firmware, and data logging. Published in HardwareX.
  • pipe-fitting-SCAD · paper
    Parametric, 3D-printable easy-connect pipe fittings in OpenSCAD.
  • open-source-bioreactor
    A composable, modular, and extensible open-source bioreactor design.

Rocketry & embedded control

  • orlab · docs
    Scripts the OpenRocket flight simulator from Python, so simulations can be batch-run in parallel and analyzed as data.
  • DCMotorServo
    An Arduino library for controlling DC motors with rotary encoders.
